lines.text: This is NextStep: a study planner for students juggling classes, work, and life.
Meet Tobi. Tobi is fictional: a second-year student who works shifts at a print shop and rides the bus home.
lines.say: Meet Toby. Toby is fictional: a second-year student who works shifts at a print shop and rides the bus home.

lines.text: Every day starts with Today: only what's realistic, the next session, and why it matters. Yesterday, three sessions didn't happen. That's okay.
When plans change, Tobi taps 'My plans changed', picks 'I have less time', and says forty-five minutes.
lines.say: When plans change, Toby taps 'My plans changed', picks 'I have less time', and says forty-five minutes.

lines.text: NextStep shows exactly what moves, with a reason for every change. Nothing changes until Tobi accepts.
lines.say: NextStep shows exactly what moves, with a reason for every change. Nothing changes until Toby accepts.

lines.text: Then there's one small next step. The focus timer is saved with timestamps, so it keeps counting even if the app closes.
Afterwards, a quick check-in records what got done, and what's left.
Finishing it earns Back on Track: once, and only for real progress.
Progress builds along the journey, with a weekly rhythm instead of fragile daily streaks.
The week fits around work, lectures, and rest. Planning, Recovery Mode, and focus all work offline after setup, and sync when you reconnect.

note: 'text' is what captions show; 'say' (optional) is a pronunciation hint for the voice.
